item.description: Colorado’s sitting first overall and playing like a team that knows exactly who it is. That said, the chatter around the league is pretty clear. The Colorado Avalanche are still expected to go get another defenseman before the March 6 trade deadline. The Denver Post's Corey Masisak’s reporting basically frames it as a near lock. item.title: Stunning Number Of Teams Have Reached Out To Flames About Blake Coleman
item.description: The Calgary Flames are not rushing anything with Blake Coleman, but the phone has not stopped ringing. Insider Frank Seravalli says 20 teams have already checked in on the veteran winger. If Calgary decides to move him, the market is going to be loud. Blake Coleman trade buzz is bigger than expected Seravalli’s note is especially interesting because Coleman has drawn more early interest than Nazem Kadri, even with Kadri being the bigger name. The simple reality is that Coleman is easier to fit.

item.title: NHL Rumors: Trade Chatter To Pick Up Around Morgan Rielly
item.description: The Toronto Maple Leafs keep trying to steady the ship, but the spiral is continuing it's downtrend. After a brief stretch of points in early December, they slid again, and the noise around real change is back to full volume. Insider David Pagnotta thinks that is when Morgan Rielly’s name starts circulating more often, because a move of that size is one of the few ways Toronto can actually change the feel of this team. item.title: Report: Multiple teams reached out with contract offer to Marc-Andre Fleury
item.description: The NHL's goalie market is so razor thin, teams are still reaching out to non-active goaltenders trying to convince them to come back. There's been multiple reports that Marc-Andre Fleury has heard from a number of teams about the potential of an NHL comeback.Probably not surprising but hearing that some teams have checked in on Marc-Andre Fleury to see if there’s any chance at all he would consider playing again. Again not surprised teams with goalie needs would want to check on it.— Pierre LeB

item.title: Canucks Executing A 'Hybrid Retool'; Don't Expect These 12 Players To Be Traded
item.description: Vancouver Canucks GM Patrik Allvin made an appearance on Amazon Prime's intermission panel this week, and told the crew that his team is undergoing what he calls a 'hybrid retool.' What that really means is, from all accounts, don't expect a mass sell-off. In particular, 12 players are likely going nowhere.
